title: Harmony Analysis
statementMd:
The semester is already ending, so Danil made an effort and decided to visit a lesson on harmony analysis to know how does the professor look like, at least. Danil was very bored on this lesson until the teacher gave the group a simple task: find $4$ vectors in $4$-dimensional space, such that every coordinate of every vector is $1$ or $- 1$ and any two vectors are orthogonal. Just as a reminder, two vectors in $*n*$-dimensional space are considered to be orthogonal if and only if their scalar product is equal to zero, that is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9209cd1e676116390c8a0e27584fa6eda10b80e3.png)

.

Danil quickly managed to come up with the solution for this problem and the teacher noticed that the problem can be solved in a more general case for $2^{*k*}$ vectors in $2^{*k*}$-dimensinoal space. When Danil came home, he quickly came up with the solution for this problem. Can you cope with it?

## Input

The only line of the input contains a single integer $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 9$).

## Output

Print $2^{*k*}$ lines consisting of $2^{*k*}$ characters each. The $*j*$-th character of the $*i*$-th line must be equal to '$*$' if the $*j*$-th coordinate of the $*i*$-th vector is equal to $- 1$, and must be equal to '$+$' if it's equal to $+ 1$. It's guaranteed that the answer always exists.

If there are many correct answers, print any.

## Note

Consider all scalar products in example:

- Vectors $1$ and $2$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) = 0$
- Vectors $1$ and $3$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- Vectors $1$ and $4$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- Vectors $2$ and $3$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- Vectors $2$ and $4$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- Vectors $3$ and $4$: $( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) = 0$
statementZhMd:
学期即将结束，Danil 终于鼓起勇气，决定去旁听一节和谐分析课，至少先看看教授长什么样。在这节课上，Danil 一直感到非常无聊，直到老师给全班布置了一个简单的任务：在 $4$ 维空间中找到 $4$ 个向量，使得每个向量的每个坐标都是 $1$ 或 $- 1$，并且任意两个向量都正交。提醒一下，$*n*$ 维空间中的两个向量当且仅当它们的数量积等于零时才被认为是正交的，即：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9209cd1e676116390c8a0e27584fa6eda10b80e3.png)

Danil 很快就想出了这个问题的解法，老师注意到，对于 $2^{*k*}$ 个 $2^{*k*}$ 维空间中的向量，这个问题同样可以推广求解。回到家后，Danil 很快就解决了这个问题。你能完成它吗？

## 输入格式

输入仅包含一行，一个整数 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 9$）。

## 输出格式

输出 $2^{*k*}$ 行，每行包含 $2^{*k*}$ 个字符。第 $i$ 行的第 $j$ 个字符必须为 '$*$'，当且仅当第 $i$ 个向量的第 $j$ 个坐标等于 $- 1$；如果该坐标等于 $+ 1$，则必须为 '$+$'。保证答案总是存在。

如果有多个正确答案，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

考虑样例中的所有数量积：

- 向量 $1$ 和 $2$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) = 0$
- 向量 $1$ 和 $3$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- 向量 $1$ 和 $4$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- 向量 $2$ 和 $3$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- 向量 $2$ 和 $4$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( - 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( - 1)·( + 1) = 0$
- 向量 $3$ 和 $4$：$( + 1)·( + 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( - 1) + ( + 1)·( + 1) = 0$
